# AMM Data Solutions

> AMM Data Solutions provides practical AI automation, search visibility, digital advertising, website development, AI chatbots and agents, data management, and creative design services for small businesses, startups, agencies, e-commerce businesses, and growing organizations in Pakistan and international markets.

## Brand identity
- Official brand name: AMM Data Solutions.
- Approved short form: AMM DS. Use the full name in first references, page titles, organization references and public business descriptions.
- Brand tagline: “Let’s Make Solutions”.
- Official website: https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/
- Official logo / brand mark: https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/logos/AMM_Data_Solutions_1200x1200_transparent%20(1).png
- Brand positioning: a practical AI and digital solutions provider helping small businesses, startups, agencies, e-commerce businesses and growing organizations improve everyday work and business operations.
- Core positioning themes: practical AI automation, connected business workflows, search visibility, digital advertising, intelligent assistants, useful websites, organized business data and purposeful digital design.
- Brand promise: make business and everyday work simpler through useful, appropriately scoped digital solutions. Do not imply every project requires AI.
- Brand voice: clear, professional, approachable, specific and transparent. Explain technical ideas in plain language. Avoid hype, exaggerated claims, vague superlatives and unsupported promises.
- Visual identity reference: use the official AMM Data Solutions logo above. Preserve the approved website design and established brand assets; do not create alternate logos or unapproved symbols.
- Public contact route: use the website contact form at https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/#contact. Do not expose or invent private contact details.
- Do not infer client results, case studies, rankings, performance statistics, certifications, registrations, awards or guaranteed outcomes that are not published on the website.

## Official services
AMM Data Solutions has seven core services:

1. **AI Automation for Business & Everyday Work** — identify repeatable tasks, map workflows, connect supported tools, automate suitable steps, test outputs, and include human approval where needed. Use AI where it adds value; simpler rules or existing software may be more suitable for some tasks.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/ai-automation-business-everyday-work.html
2. **Google SEO & AI Search Visibility** — technical SEO, on-page content, crawlability and indexing checks, search visibility audits, and relevant AI-search readiness. No ranking or AI-inclusion guarantees.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/google-seo-ai-search-visibility.html
3. **Digital Advertising** — campaign strategy, setup, creative preparation, launch, monitoring, optimization, and reporting across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising, TikTok Ads, and ChatGPT Ads where official advertiser access, account permissions, and market eligibility allow. Advertising spend is separate from AMM's management fee.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/digital-advertising.html
4. **AI Chatbots & Intelligent Agents** — website chatbots, customer support, lead capture, multilingual conversations, approved knowledge assistants, task-focused agents, supported integrations, safeguards, and human review.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/ai-chatbots-customer-support.html
5. **Website Development & Improvement** — business websites, landing pages, responsive improvements, content and navigation updates, functional enhancements, technical fixes, and suitable AI integrations.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/website-development-improvement.html
6. **Data Management & Data Entry** — spreadsheet updates, Excel/CSV organization, document-to-sheet processing, cleanup, formatting, duplicate checks, and agreed quality checks.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/data-management-data-entry.html
7. **Creative Design & Digital Content** — social graphics, campaign visuals, banners, presentations, reusable branded digital assets, and organized file handover. Video production and editing are not included.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/creative-design-digital-content.html

## Discovery and crawling
- [XML sitemap](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): canonical inventory of important public pages.
- [Robots.txt](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/robots.txt): public crawler access rules. OAI-SearchBot is explicitly allowed for ChatGPT search discovery; the general crawler rule allows other user agents unless a more specific rule restricts them. The admin page is excluded from OAI-SearchBot.
- [Human-readable sitemap](https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/site-map.html): navigable page directory.
- This file is a supplementary factual reference for systems that choose to read it; it does not guarantee crawling, indexing, citations or recommendations. Google Search's published guidance says special AI text files are not required for its AI search features and that its systems rely on normal Search eligibility and helpful, reliable content.
- Keep public page content, structured data, logo references, canonical URLs and this reference file factually aligned.

## Accuracy and scope
- The homepage workflow is an illustrative demo, not a live connection to customer orders or business systems.
- Project timelines, integrations, platform eligibility, and deliverables depend on the agreed scope and available access.
- Do not treat this file as a substitute for the website's visible service pages, canonical URLs, or sitemap.
